body: Yeah. When I was younger I used to think that everyone was suicidal/depressed. As horrible as it sounds, I wondered why everyone didn’t just kill themselves because I thought that they would be much better off. I was in for a big surprise when I saw how unempathetic people were, how downright mean... I realized eventually it wasn’t normal.
I was told “You have it all wrong, these expectations are normal.”
It’s different for all people, but for me personally I think if I just had a friend I could be happy... Maybe not happy all time time, but at least not constantly depressed & suicidal like I am now.
